gem_guidance.text: Note on gemming: Based on the above assumptions, Stamina gems are generally recommended in every slot as they provide the most efficient EHP increase in a single slot. However, certain gear pieces will be listed with gems of other colors so that the overall gear set will meet the color requirements of the Relentless Earthstorm Diamond Meta gem.

Stag-Helm of Malorne is the highest overall value tanking helm for bears in Phase 1, and is massively better than alternatives. The upgrade from pre-raid gear to the Tier 4 helm is so large that competitive raiding guilds should prioritize the helm token for feral tanks. Note that while green gems are generally very inefficient for bears, it is recommended in this slot to meet the Meta gem requirements for Relentless Earthstorm Diamond .

Breastplate of Malorne is the best chest piece to use in any Phase 1 gear set, both for tanking and for DPS. Note that the recommended gems are a compromise between optimizing for tanking and DPS, given that the color choices are constrained by the Relentless Earthstorm Diamond Meta requirements.
